propositions: Deterministic AST gate must detect prohibited env/config reads (6 categories: ambient env, helper-shim, load_config, literal-getattr, provider-credential, backend-registry access) only in modules outside approved composition-root and provider-credential-boundary seams

Gate must reuse gen_env_registry.scan, KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS, and env matchers as single source; detect receiver-aliasing evasions (src = os.environ; src.get(...)); fail closed on unresolved/dynamic env reads and shims absent from the table

Approved-seam and owner registries must derive credentials from _child_env.owned_secret_names, backend keys from static @register decorator scan (not empty import-time _REGISTRY), env baseline from gen_env_registry + _deprecations; reject path-glob exceptions structurally
Legacy-exception set must enumerate current below-seam reads as exact path+symbol+rationale entries so gate is introducible without product-code changes; C3 drains exception set to empty

Gate must expose check(root)->list[str] and main(argv)->int contracts; synthetic fixtures for all 6 categories with direct/import-aliased/local-aliased forms must fail with expected diagnostics; clean approved fixtures and current tree must pass
